paragraphs: Nordic American Tankers Limited was formed on June 12, 1995, and organized under the laws of the Islands of Bermuda as an exempted company limited by shares pursuant to the

Companies Act. We maintain our principal office and registered office at Par La Ville Place, 14 Par La Ville Street, Hamilton HM 08, Bermuda. Our telephone number at such address is (441) 292-7202 and we maintain an internet site at www.nat.bm.

The SEC maintains an Internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC. The address of the SEC's internet site is www.sec.gov. None of the

information contained on these websites is incorporated into or forms a part of this annual report. Our common shares trade under the symbol "NAT" on the New York Stock Exchange, or the NYSE. NAT's shares were admitted for listing on the NYSE in

November 2004 and were traded on the American Stock Exchange, or AMEX, before that. NYSE Euronext acquired the AMEX in 2008 and is now known as the NYSE American. NAT also had a dual listing on the Oslo Stock Exchange until early 2005 when the
We are an international tanker company focusing solely on owning, operating and chartering of Suezmax tankers. In 2022, we sold

five vessels built in 2002 and 2003, and we took delivery of two newbuildings, Nordic Harrier and Nordic Hunter, built at Samsung shipyard in South Korea. In 2023, we acquired the 2016-built Nordic Hawk. In 2025 we sold off the 2003-built

Nordic Apollo and the 2004-built Nordic Castor and we took delivery of two 2016-built vessels Nordic Galaxy and Nordic Moon. Our fleet counted 20 vessels as of December 31, 2025. After 2025, we signed an agreement to build two new suezmax

tankers with a South-Korean yard, with delivery in the second half of 2028. Under the commercial terms, the first installment fell due in the second quarter of 2026, with subsequent installment payable through the delivery of the vessel. No

payments have been capitalized in 2025. The vessels will be financed well in advance of delivery in 2028. We plan to pay the first instalments with cash. So far in 2026 we have sold and delivered the 2004-built Nordic Luna and the 2005-built

Nordic Sprinter. Both these vessels were classified as held for sale as of December 31, 2025. Also, after year-end, we have entered into firm agreements to sell the 2005-built Nordic Skier and the 2003-built Nordic Pollux. Following these
transactions, our fleet will count 16 suezmax tankers (excluding newbuildings).
The vessels in our fleet are homogenous and interchangeable, which is a business strategy we refer to as the "Nordic American System".

Changes in the price of fuel and regulations may adversely affect our profits.
Inability to renew the fleet would adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition and ability to pay dividends.

Our results of operations are subject to seasonal fluctuations, which may adversely affect our financial condition.

The value of our vessels may be depressed at the time we decide to sell a vessel.
Delays or defaults by the shipyards in the construction of newbuildings could increase our expenses and diminish our net income and cash flows.
Terrorist attacks and international hostilities and instability can affect the tanker industry, which could adversely affect our business.

If we do not manage relationships with customers or successfully integrate any acquired Suezmax tankers, we may not be able to grow or effectively manage our growth.
Because some of our expenses are incurred in foreign currencies, we are exposed to exchange rate fluctuations, which could negatively affect our results of operations.
Risks Related to the Operations of Our Vessels and Regulations
The operation of Suezmax tankers involves certain unique operational risks.
We operate our Suezmax tankers worldwide and as a result, our vessels are exposed to international risks which may reduce revenue or increase expenses.
The smuggling of drugs or other contraband onto our vessels may lead to governmental claims against us.
Failure to comply with the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act could result in fines, criminal penalties and an adverse effect on our business.
Acts of piracy on ocean-going vessels could adversely affect our business.
paragraphs: The following constitutes a summary of the material risks relevant to an investment in our company. The occurrence of any of the events described in this section could significantly and
negatively affect our business, financial condition, operating results or cash available for dividends or the trading price of our common stock.
If the Suezmax tanker industry, which historically has been cyclical and volatile, is depressed in the future, our revenues, earnings and available cash flow may decrease.

Conducting business in certain jurisdictions, including Venezuela, as well as exposure to geopolitical tensions in other regions, such as Iran and the Strait of Hormuz, may subject us to legal, regulatory, political and other risks
that could have an adverse effect on our operations and financial results.

We are dependent on spot charters and any decrease in spot charter rates in the future may adversely affect our earnings, our ability to pay dividends and our ability to repay our financial liabilities.

paragraphs: Our fleet as of December 31, 2025, consisted of 20 Suezmax crude oil tankers. In 2023, we acquired the 2016 built Nordic Hawk. There were no

changes to our fleet during 2024. In 2025 we took delivery of two 2016 build vessels Nordic Galaxy and Nordic Moon. We entered into firm sales agreements for the 2003 built Nordic Apollo, the 2004 built Nordic Castor, the 2004 built Nordic

Luna and the 2005 built Nordic Sprinter, but the latter two vessels were only delivered to the buyers in January 2026. Subsequent to December 31, 2025, we also entered into an agreement to purchase two new build suezmax tankers from a South

Korean shipyard with delivery in 2028. We have sold two more vessels in 2026, the 2003 build Nordic Pollux and the 2005 build Nordic Skier, where one has been delivered to the new buyer, the other is still pending delivery.
The vessels in our fleet are considered homogenous and interchangeable as they have approximately the same freight capacity and ability to transport the same type of cargo.

headings: 與我們業務及財務狀況相關的風險
若未來蘇伊士型油輪產業持續低迷，而此產業歷來具有週期性與波動性，則我們的營業收入、獲利及現金流可能減少。
在委內瑞拉從事業務可能使我們面臨法律、監管、政治及其他風險，這些風險可能對我們的營運及財務結果產生負面影響。
我們依賴散裝租賃，若未來散裝租賃價格下降，可能對我們的獲利、支付股息的能力及
燃料價格變動及規範的變化可能對我們的利潤產生負面影響。
無法更新船隊將對我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況及支付股息的能力產生負面影響。
國際蘇伊士型油輪產業已經歷波動的租賃率與船舶價值，且無法保證這些租賃率與船舶價值
我們的營運成果受季節性波動影響，可能對我們的財務狀況產生不利影響。
消費者需求從石油轉向其他能源來源，或原油與精煉油產品貿易模式的變化，可能對我們產生重大不利影響。
我們在決定出售船舶時，船舶價值可能低於市場水平。
造船廠在建造新船時的延誤或違約，可能增加我們的費用，並降低我們的淨收入與現金流。
恐怖攻擊與國際敵對行動及不穩定情勢可能影響油輪產業，進而對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們依賴資訊系統進行營運，若無法防範資訊系統遭安全入侵，可能對我們的業務與營運成果產生不利影響。
若我們無法管理與客戶的關係，或成功整合任何取得的蘇伊士型油輪，我們可能無法成長或有效管理成長。
因為部分費用是以外幣計價，我們面臨匯率波動的風險，這可能會對我們的營運成果產生負面影響。
與我們船舶運作及規範相關的風險
蘇伊士型油輪的運作涉及某些獨特的運作風險。
我們在全球範圍內運作蘇伊士型油輪，因此，我們的船舶面臨國際風險，這可能會降低收入或增加費用。
毒品或其他違禁品被帶上我們的船舶，可能會導致政府對我們提出索賠。
未能遵守美國外國腐敗行為防治法，可能會導致罰款、刑事處罰，並對我們的業務產生負面影響。
對海上船舶的盜賊行為可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 以下為投資本公司之重要風險摘要。本節所描述之任何事件發生，可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果或可用於發放股息之現金，以及普通股之交易價格產生顯著且負面之影響。
若蘇伊士型油輪產業，該產業歷來具有週期性與波動性，未來若陷入低迷，本公司之營業收入、獲利及可用現金流量可能減少。

在某些司法管轄區域進行營運，包括委內瑞拉，以及在其他地區如伊朗及霍爾木茲海峽所面臨的國際政治緊張關係，可能使本公司面臨法律、法規、政治及其他風險
